explain: The sky appears blue because sunlight is scattered in all directions by the gases and particles in Earth's atmosphere, with blue light being scattered more than other colors because it travels in shorter, smaller waves. This phenomenon, known as Rayleigh scattering, causes our eyes to perceive the sky as predominantly blue during the day.
